sections.title: Validated model areas
sections.description: Core relationships and reference domains that reconcile cleanly in the Explorer.

items.title: Class hierarchy integrity
items.summary: Tag and Equipment Class hierarchies resolve without unresolved parent references.
evidence: Property inheritance is evaluated across both class domains by the Explorer repositories.

items.title: RDL object-family coverage
items.summary: All 21 definition-file families in the CORE RDL are classified by the Explorer model.
evidence: The validation snapshot is regenerated from the current workbook rather than browser-local diagnostic state.

items.title: Property and controlled-value model
items.summary: Property, Property Picklist and Picklist Value relationships reconcile consistently.
evidence: 368 master Property Picklists and 3,027 Picklist Value rows.

items.title: Measurement dimensions
items.summary: Atomic and compound Unit-of-Measure dimension expressions reconcile to the canonical dimension catalogue.
evidence: 179 distinct dimension components found in Property/Unit references; 0 unresolved.
20 compound Unit dimension expressions parsed component-by-component.

items.title: Property grouping semantics
items.summary: Property Grouping purpose references can be reconciled against the RDL purpose family.

sections.title: Data-quality findings
sections.description: Specific source-data inconsistencies supported by workbook-level evidence.

items.title: POSC CAESAR equivalence mappings reference absent RDL objects
items.summary: 37 external-equivalence mappings reference CFIHOS object IDs absent from the master catalogue.
evidence: 3,091 equivalence mappings inspected; 3,054 resolve and 37 do not.
35 unresolved IDs sit numerically between surviving objects from the same RDL family.

items.title: Equipment requirements reference Tag-only classes
items.summary: 10 CORE class-document requirement rows are typed as Equipment while referencing 2 Tag-only class identifiers.
evidence: The generator does not silently substitute an Equipment counterpart.

items.title: Master Source Standard requirements have no requirement-layer usage
items.summary: 4 master requirement objects are referenced by neither CORE class-document requirements nor the JIP33 overlay.

items.title: Condition Model is currently dormant

items.title: Submission Reference Date family
items.summary: 7 Submission Reference Date master definitions are present; usage should be interpreted separately from literal reference-date values.
evidence: The family is retained as a semantic clarification item rather than treated as a structural failure.
